subject: Documentation for generic0-model and log(|C|) term up to date?

messages.author: 6037cfff64134348
messages.subject: Documentation for generic0-model and log(|C|) term up to date?
parts:
Hi INLA-list,

I'm trying to get accurate marginal maximum likelihood values with the generic0 latent model and am trying to track down a bug in my code. The documentation [1] says that the log(|C|) term is not computed. Can you please confirm that this is still the case?

I briefly tried inputting a (small, dense) singular Cmatrix to verify this, and it did fail within a sparse matrix factorization routine, which may be an indication that INLA tries to factor the matrix even if the documentation says otherwise? (Though I guess it could mean any other number of things too.)

Dag Sverre Seljebotn

[1] http://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/r-inla.org/doc/latent/generic0.pdf
